heading: Records centers and centralized microfilming or digitization services
lead: The Archivist may establish, maintain, and operate records centers and centralized microfilming or digitization services for Federal agencies.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 2907, Pub. L. 90–620, Oct. 22, 1968, 82 Stat. 1297, contained provisions similar to those comprising this section, prior to repeal by Pub. L. 94–575, § 2(a)(3).

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2014—Pub. L. 113–187 inserted “or digitization” after “microfilming” in section catchline and text. 1984—Pub. L. 98–497 substituted “Archivist” for “Administrator”.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1984 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 98–497 effective Apr. 1, 1985, see section 301 of Pub. L. 98–497, set out as a note under section 2102 of this title.

ancestors.heading: RECORDS MANAGEMENT BY THE ARCHIVIST OF THE UNITED STATES AND BY THE ADMINISTRATOR OF GENERAL SERVICES
